atoms.name: Concept hierarchies
atoms.one_line: Levels run from specific to general, such as City, State, Country.

atoms.name: Roll-up and drill-down
atoms.one_line: Roll-up climbs to a coarser level; drill-down descends to a finer one; slice and dice do not change levels.

atoms.name: Cuboid count with hierarchies
atoms.one_line: Each dimension offers (levels + 1) choices including ALL; multiply across dimensions.

atoms.name: Cells in a cuboid
atoms.one_line: Multiply the number of distinct values at the chosen level of each dimension.

atoms.name: Measure categories
atoms.one_line: Distributive (SUM, COUNT, MIN, MAX), algebraic (AVG, standard deviation), holistic (MEDIAN, MODE, RANK).

atoms.name: Computing measures from partial aggregates
atoms.one_line: AVG = total sum / total count; variance needs count, sum and sum of squares.

atoms.name: Aggregating along a hierarchy
atoms.one_line: Distributive measures roll up directly; averages need weights; medians need raw data.

atoms.name: Measures versus dimension attributes
atoms.one_line: Measures are numbers you aggregate; dimension attributes describe context and group the data.
